notes:
Inbound from product lead (Co-founder, Marc Redd). Self-serve signup on 2025-11-01; ran simple echo test with streaming -> saw ~85ms median, unsure about tail. Wants hosted API for quick time-to-market.

Shorthand from discovery call 11/03:
- Primary product: in-app chat assistant embedded in B2B CRM product (agent-facing + customer-facing).
- Traffic profile: multi-tenant, 10-30 reqs/sec initially, bursty at EOD due to batch imports. Expect growth to 200-300 rps over 12mo.
- SLAs wanted: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 150ms, p99 target < 300ms (ambitious). Streaming required (token-level SSE or websocket) for perceived latency.
- Models: prefer open model family or small proprietary finetune; happy to start with curated Llama-2/Redwood-verified variant. Cost-sensitive but values latency first.
- Security: SSO (SAML) for internal tooling, audit logs, US data residency. No air-gap required.
- Billing: wants estimate for 6mo commit once POC shows p99 within target.
- Quote: "We need the chat to feel instantaneous for agents — streaming is non-negotiable."

Quick wins identified: pre-warm KV cache for frequent prefixes, lower-latency routing for US-east, sample batch config for short-turn dialogues. POC asks: a small sandbox account with 50k token credits + streaming example; sample config values for batching and caching.

Contact cadence: AE has weekly check-ins for two weeks; SE to run 30m tech session w/ infra/FE. Legal loop started (security FAQ shared).
